Interface MachineWorld

@NonExtendable public interface MachineWorld
What a machine can see and do in the world around it (MachineContext.world()). Every call happens at once, on the owner thread; positions of blocks owned by another thread (Folia: another region) or not loaded read as empty and are never changed.

  • Method Details

    • blockAt

      @Nullable @Nullable net.kyori.adventure.key.Key blockAt(@NotNull @NotNull BlockPosition position)
      The block at position: a CraftEngine block's id, or a vanilla block's (e.g. minecraft:air); null if not loaded or not owned by this thread.

    • fluidAt

      @Nullable @Nullable WorldFluid fluidAt(@NotNull @NotNull BlockPosition position)
      The fluid in the block at position, or null if there is none, or it is not loaded or owned.

    • blockHardness

      float blockHardness(@NotNull @NotNull BlockPosition position)
      How hard the block at position is to break (vanilla hardness); -1 if unbreakable or unknown.

    • redstonePower

      int redstonePower()
      The redstone signal this machine's block receives (0 to 15).

    • placeFluid

      boolean placeFluid(@NotNull @NotNull BlockPosition position, @NotNull @NotNull net.kyori.adventure.key.Key fluid)
      Places a source block of the platform's fluid (e.g. minecraft:water) where there is air or flowing fluid.

    • takeFluid

      boolean takeFluid(@NotNull @NotNull BlockPosition position)
      Removes the fluid source block at position; false if there is none or it is not owned.

    • placeBlock

      boolean placeBlock(@NotNull @NotNull BlockPosition position, @NotNull @NotNull net.kyori.adventure.key.Key block)
      Places the vanilla block block (e.g. minecraft:stone) where there is air or a fluid.

    • breakBlock

      boolean breakBlock(@NotNull @NotNull BlockPosition position)
      Breaks the block at position, its drops falling as items; false if it could not. Machines and transports are never broken.

    • collectItems

      @NotNull @NotNull List<ResourceStack> collectItems(@NotNull @NotNull BlockPosition position)
      Takes the dropped items lying in the block at position (e.g. a tractor beam), as resources.

    • setBlockProperty

      void setBlockProperty(@NotNull @NotNull String property, @NotNull @NotNull String value)
      Shows a state of the machine on its block: sets the block property property (e.g. a valve's mode) to value, if the block has it and allows that value.

    • playSound

      void playSound(@NotNull @NotNull net.kyori.adventure.key.Key sound, float volume, float pitch)
      Plays the platform's sound at the machine.

    • particleLine

      void particleLine(@NotNull @NotNull BlockPosition to, int color)
      Draws particles from the machine to to (a beam), e.g. minecraft:dust in color (RGB).
